review: home layout B 'Quiet Home', round 4 (one-time, narrow), LOOK lens (independent reviewer)
summary: R3-B1 is fixed and nothing else moved. On the 768x1024 upright tablet, Kinu's Sewing Club and Marumi's Strike Lane still move the chip down (.news-down), and lowerNews now sets --dock-h to the dock's measured height (156px when it folds 2x2). The chip now sits at 24,768 320x56. That is exactly 20 px above the top row of icons (dock top 844), 100 px left of the CO-OP tab (x 444) and the plate, and 436-457 px below her face core. The FREE sticker on RECRUIT (top about y 843) is clear of the chip's lower edge too. elementFromPoint at the centre of every home control returns that control: 14 of 14 on every picture at every size, 60 cases. The chip-down layout reads balanced. The chip and the CO-OP tab form one band above the dock and the plate: tops 768 and 772 for a one-line chip, 756 and 772 for a two-line one. The 2x2 icons sit below the chip, and her face and body are untouched above. When the chip turns to a two-line page (Daily gift, Weekly bosses) it grows upward to 756-824, with the gap to the icons still 20 px. A box-by-box compare with round 3's metrics (chip, dock, plate, CO-OP, top bar, picture box, face placement) is identical for all 12 views (default stand plus 11 full illustrations) at 360x800, 390x844 and 768x1024. The only differences are the chip on 768x1024 kinu-scene and marumi-scene (y 844 to 768). At 844x390 and 1280x720 news-down never fires, and the full illustrations match round 3's look. node e2e/lobby-illustrations.mjs --sizes 768x1024,360x800,390x844,844x390,1280x720 --tap-sizes none: PASS, 939 checks, 0 FAIL, including 58 'takes a tap at its centre' checks (the new per-illustration check among them). No page errors. The bond hint copy change (R3-L2) is in: the tooltip now reads 'raised by time together and gifts in the City'.
environment_note: 4 CPUs, other agents running. Headless Playwright Chromium 153 (SwiftShader), loaded from /opt/node22/lib/node_modules/playwright via PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE, through e2e/browser.mjs launchChromium(). Dev server npx vite --port 5297 --strictPort; the e2e script started its own server. Seeded as e2e/lobby-illustrations.mjs does: seedInkSave plus Yoriko and the seven academy girls granted in the page, Reduce Motion, event clock 2026-10-24T18:00Z, page clock INK_NOW. Each picture was chosen through chooseBackground + store.commit('lobby-bg'), then measured after .news-wait cleared.

findings.title: (predates, not from 716b428) A two-line news page leaves a one-word orphan: 'Claim your login gift: day' / '1'
findings.detail: Seen on the chip-down layout at 768x1024 (kinu-768-page2, marumi-768-page1). It also shows wherever the 320 px chip turns to the Daily gift page. The chip itself is correctly placed and clear. This is only copy fit. Optional: shorten it to 'Claim day 1's login gift', or keep 'day N' together with a non-breaking space.

findings.title: (content, code comments only) bgPicker.js lines 2 and 11 and lobbyArt.js lines 13 and 185 still say 'date' or 'dating'
findings.detail: The player-facing tooltip is fixed ('Bond level — raised by time together and gifts in the City (coming soon)'). The words remain only in code comments, which no player sees. For consistency, they could say 'time together' too.

findings.title: (note) After a resize, the chip can also move down at 810x1080 and 834x1112 when its page has two lines; it lands correctly
findings.detail: Round 3 probed those sizes fresh, with a one-line chip, and they did not trigger. With the two-line Weekly bosses page (68 px), lowerNews moves the chip down after a resize. It still sits 20 px above the 2x2 dock (810: y 812-880, dock 900; 834: y 844-912, dock 932), 142-166 px from CO-OP, with 14 of 14 taps OK. This shows --dock-h measured fresh on each move. No change asked.
